inputs.text: Vertical medium shot in the same apartment study. The same adult Chinese woman age 28 sits safely at the wooden desk, smartphone placed face-up and inactive. Her hands are lowering from her face after a deep relieved breath and she looks directly toward camera with calm gratitude and renewed clarity. Same oval face, dark brown eyes, low ponytail, light blue shirt, dark charcoal blazer and thin silver necklace. Premium handcrafted 3D plush stop-motion film, soft flocked fabric and fine fibers, rounded chibi adult proportions, lighting now gently warm and reassuring, clean negative space in upper third for a later anti-fraud slogan, cinematic 50mm lens, no generated text, no watermark.
